turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to make focaccia for a barbecue this weekend. Is it hard?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's one of the friendliest breads. It's a wet dough, so there's almost no kneading.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How wet are we talking? I hate sticky hands.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pretty sticky. Oil your hands instead of flouring them, and the dough won't cling.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I like the sound of that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but I want a used phone and I can't decide where to get it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to read out a few choices, and I'll let you know when I've finished.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A refurbished one from a big electronics store, a year of warranty, but it costs more.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Someone on a local marketplace is selling the same phone for much less, meeting in a car park.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My coworker is upgrading and offered me her old one at a friend price.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Your coworker's phone is probably the best mix, cheap and you know its history. The store gives you the warranty for peace of mind, and the marketplace deal is fine if you check it carefully in person.
